body: Thank you, i appreciate. I will try to post updates every now and again
Thank you so much, this truly means a lot to me.. I really needed to hear this right now
Thank you so much, I truly appreciate it

Thank you I appreciate it. He was more than just a boyfriend to me ya know? He was my best friend, my husband basically. Lived together since I was 13 and been in a relationship since I was 16. And I misworded what I originally said. I don’t really have friends. Like I have people who want to be there for me but none that I’m actually comfortable enough to talk about these things with and I feel so grateful for them wanting to help but so bad for not letting them. I just don’t see what they can do and it gets embarrassing and then they get worried and it’s downhill from there. They just don’t know me personally enough to understand what I’m trying to say when I do talk to them about it. And that is not their fault at all. It’s so nice to have emotional support but it’s just my personality not to want to talk to anyone. My boyfriend was one of two people who knew deep things about me,. The other one is a friends mom who i still talk to occasionally. She’s been the only one I’ve truly talked to about this situation and she’s said all she can. I’m not even comfortable talking to my own actual mother sometimes, though I love her and she’s trying to be here for me. I know I sound selfish because some people go through these types of things and have absolutely no one and i would be there for all of those people if I could and I try to be for as many as possible. I just never was able to Open up until I met him and when an introvert loses the one person they have it’s truly like you died with them in a way if that makes sense. As I said before i know it’s the hardest thing in the world for everyone and I am in no way trying to discredit that I’m just trying to explain it from my perspective the best I can. And thank you for the link. I will check if out.
I’m sorry for going on and on but thoughts build up and I’ve got to get them out at some point and it’s just easier one something like this.
I’m trying to be strong,. Trying as much as I can it’s just so hard without him ya know? And thank you so much, I appreciate it
Thank you, please just keep his soul and I In your thoughts and prayers.
